//: Typechecks supabase/functions/**, which tsconfig.json deliberately does not:
its include is [src, vite.config.ts], so the Edge Function source sat outside
every gate this repo has. A type error in push-notify would have been caught
by nothing and would first appear as a failed deploy or a production runtime
Run it with: npm run typecheck:functions
WHAT THIS CATCHES: everything about OUR code. Wrong property names, wrong
argument counts, a value of the wrong type moving between index.ts, send.ts,
payload.ts and endpoint.ts, a missing await, an unhandled null. That is the
class of mistake the gap actually exposed us to.
WHAT IT DOES NOT CATCH: whether we are right about Deno or about web-push.
Both are declared in _shims/ because neither is installed here, so the check
agrees with our beliefs about them. supabase-js is the exception — it maps to
the real installed package below, so those types are genuine. This is not a
substitute for `deno check`; it is the part of that job available without
Deno, which is not on this machine.
Tests beside the function are excluded: they import from src/, which the app
tsconfig governs under different settings, and vitest runs them anyway.
